text:
Ana: alert 10:03 UTC — sudden spike in TLS handshake rejects from eu-central-1 and ap-south-1. Attached logs show peers rejecting key-ids.
Vik: can you paste one line?
Ana: here:
```n2026-04-02T10:02:48Z proxy: TLS handshake failed: unknown-key-id 'ephemeral-zz-113' region=eu-central-1 peer=svc-payments
```n
Sam: we shipped an RBAC tightening yesterday that added a Condition limiting kms:Decrypt to region=us-east-1. Rotator needs cross-region unwraps.
ci-bot: rotator excerpt:
```n2026-04-02T09:58:12Z ERROR unwrap key=ephemeral-zz-113 err=KMS::AccessDenied principal=svc/rotator region=eu-central-1
```n
Vik: symptom matches. If rotator can't unwrap, proxies can still present stale key-ids which peers reject.
Ana: mitigation options? revert RBAC, grant rotator explicit kms:Decrypt on ephemeral keys, or force rotator run.
Sam: revert then grant. I'll revert the gitops commit now and follow with a targeted allow.
oncall-bot: Incident SEC-2026-04-02-001 created. Owners: Ana, Sam.
Sam: rollback applied 10:07 UTC. rotator now:
```n2026-04-02T10:08:02Z INFO unwrap succeeded key=ephemeral-zz-113 principal=svc/rotator
2026-04-02T10:08:30Z INFO rotation complete for svc-payments
```n
Vik: restarted edge proxies in eu-central-1 and ap-south-1 to purge cached key refs.
Ana: monitoring shows TLS rejects drop to baseline by 10:12 UTC. Marking mitigated.
Sam: postmortem actions:
- add CI test that simulates RBAC prune and verifies rotator unwraps
- add alert: rotator KMS::AccessDenied >3 in 5m correlated to handshake fails
- update RBAC templates to explicitly allow svc/rotator when region conditions are present
- include runbook snippet for KMS::AccessDenied during rotation
Vik: I'll own the RBAC template updates; Sam owns the CI test.
Ana: runbook snippet to add:
```nIf rotator KMS::AccessDenied:
1) check recent IAM/gitops diffs
2) rollback offending PR or grant rotator kms:Decrypt on affected keys
3) watch rotator until unwraps succeed
4) restart regional proxies if handshake errors persist
```n
Sam: noted, will follow up with PRs. Closing after postmortem doc is posted. :thumbsup:
